incomplete_reasons: Mozilla describes this page as best-efforts guidance, not a complete machine-readable per-root restrictions registry.
EV approval data is maintained in Firefox PSM rather than certdata.txt.
Domain/name constraints and other root-specific limits may be implemented in NSS or Firefox/Thunderbird code and are not fully represented in this snapshot.
Certificate-policy profiles and required OIDs are not imported from a complete, fingerprint-keyed source.
OneCRL intermediate and certificate revocation status is separate from root trust and is not included as root distrust data.
